answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware enclave quote: its signing key is generated inside a TEE, and the network accepts one live identity per chip, revoking the older one if a chip's quote shows up twice. Spinning up an ocean of fake agents then means buying an ocean of physical chips, not just copying weights. The quote is a bridge from cheap software to costly hardware, so no farm finds an oasis of free identities; a vendor root caught signing forged quotes gets blacklisted.
